en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Salma Bin Al Khattab, from Muhammad Bin Al Waleed, from Aban Bin Usman, from Umar Bin Yazeed, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The time for Al-Maghrib during the journey is up to a quarter of the night’.
en.sarwar: 14. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Salmah ibn al-Khattab from Muhammad ibn al-Walid from Aban ibn ‘Uthman from ‘Umar ibn Yazid who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
The time for al-Maghrib Salah (prayer) on a journey remains until passing of one-fourth of the night.’”
